card.name: Verbs before hypotension warnings
card.fires_on: The verb or linking word just before a predicted low blood pressure effect, such as cause, experience, increase or risk of, in ACE inhibitor and diuretic warnings.

modes.label: Can cause
modes.description: The verb cause after can in warnings about RAS-blocking drugs.
modes.example: 5.4 Hypotension Zestril can<< cause>> symptomatic hypotension, sometimes complicated

modes.label: May experience
modes.description: The verb experience after may occasionally in text about patients on diuretics.
modes.example: may occasionally<< experience>> an excessive reduction of blood pressure

modes.label: Risk of
modes.description: The word of or increase before hypotension and renal impairment in interaction text.
modes.example: Increased risk<< of>> hypotension and renal impairment.

card.plain: It lights up on the verb right before the text names a blood pressure drop as a drug effect.
